summary.text: Denise Baum is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 45, where Ballotpedia lists her tenure as beginning in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Bryce Walston.
She lives in Billings and has worked in law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Baum lives in Billings, Montana, and her career experience includes working in law enforcement.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Judiciary, Transportation and Agriculture committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
